subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and goal mode as core runtime features now, and should PR #102261 land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request adds cross-surface core behavior, protocol/API shape, channel delivery, UI rendering, and goal-driver semantics, so the remaining choice is maintainer product and ownership intent rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Split staged PRs
options.body: Keep this hub open and ask for staged review of the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with focused proof for each surface.

options.title: Sponsor full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and finish proof, conflict resolution, and rollout decisions on PR #102261.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintainers can reject or narrow the roadmap if these primitives should wait or move behind a smaller plugin/API design first.

recommendation.title: Split staged PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and ask for staged review of the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with focused proof for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on Codex harness, strict-agentic, and update_plan direction.
